thesis: ViTrox is a strong business priced for strong growth; the fresh Layer 1 data supports quality but does not provide a sufficient margin of safety at the current price.
strongest_counterexample: A sustained semiconductor-capex upcycle could make the forward multiple reasonable as earnings compound.
invalidation_conditions: Revenue, orders, and free-cash-flow conversion accelerate enough to support the current multiple
Price consolidates above SMA-50 with volume confirmation
A material earnings miss or margin decline forces a lower valuation

No customer-level order, backlog, or concentration detail
Price history and technical indicators end on 2026-08-10
decisive_factors: 61.4% gross margin, 37.5% operating margin, and only 8.2% debt-to-equity
